answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments bind each agent to an ivory attestation that any cloned identity must reproduce a sequential zero-knowledge verifiable delay forming a deterministic spiral of hash-chained epochs. The protocol enforces staking collateral and slashing penalties that exceed any Sybil gain, yielding negative expected attack utility and a robust Nash equilibrium recorded in a global reputation atlas. Proof aggregation reduces verification cost to logarithmic rounds, enabling scalable on-chain auditing.
